title: provider-declarations.v1
description: What an operator states about each configured model provider, for `forge providers inventory`. Everything here is attested: features in use, vendor-only features and their reconstruction paths are never guessed by Forge. Rules a JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by the reader: a vendor-only feature or model listed twice, and a fallback provider_id that does not name another provider in the inventory.

tool_calling.description: Whether the system uses tool calling with this provider.

streaming.description: Whether the system streams responses from this provider.

vendor_only.description: Features only this vendor offers that the system uses. An empty list states that there are none.

models.description: Models in use. When omitted, the models Forge's registry lists for this provider are used, and the command says so.

jurisdiction.description: Fills an unknown jurisdiction, or withholds a preset's with unknown. A value that contradicts the preset's is refused.
